intent: A trial run of a Skill that declares listed MCP tools offers the agent a stand-in for each, and the run context reads those tools from ingest at dispatch; the re-cited ingest rules and the registry-run facts contract still state the same facts.
observable_outcome: The provider receives mcp_tools holding exactly the declared, unretired listed tools, and verify-evidence reports every updated citation current.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every citation in the updated records matches the lines it cites.
A trial run is dispatched with a stand-in for each declared, unretired listed MCP tool and for no other name.
